data.text: **Abstraction** is the process of hiding implementation details and exposing only the essential features of an object. It helps manage complexity by focusing on what an object does rather than how it does it.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Abstraction simplifies complex systems by exposing only what's necessary.
